verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents a REST API, with bearer-token auth and per-endpoint reference pages that include curl examples. Nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec, and the probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. Human-readable endpoint docs and a markdown docs page are adjacent material and do not count as a machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
